name: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung
short_description: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung is a half-marathon and 10 km race set for September 19, 2026, in Bandung, Indonesia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 19, 2026, in Bandung, Indonesia. The exact venue within Bandung has not yet been stated.

research_highlights: The 2026 edition is scheduled for 19-20 September 2026 in Bandung, with 10K and Half Marathon categories (moved from the usual July date used in 2024/2025 editions).
In the 2025 edition, start/finish moved from Gedung Sate to Balai Kota Bandung, and half marathon start time was pushed earlier (4:00 AM) specifically to reduce traffic disruption and finish sooner.
Bandung's cool morning climate is repeatedly cited by organizers and past participants as a favorable running condition compared to other Indonesian cities.
Course has historically run past Bandung landmarks such as Jalan Asia Afrika, Dago, Diponegoro, and Ir. H. Juanda, giving a scenic city-tour feel.
The event is hybrid: a large offline race in Bandung plus a much larger virtual race component (in 2025, roughly 16,000 ran offline versus over 30,000 virtual participants nationwide).
research_watchouts: The 2024 edition drew significant criticism after half-marathon and marathon runners had to share roads with motorbikes and cars, with some runners reporting horn-honking and even verbal abuse from drivers.

The 2025 edition caused notable traffic congestion in central Bandung (e.g. Cicadas, Kiaracondong, Viaduct areas), prompting complaints from residents and criticism from a Bandung city council member.

Local officials and city planners have publicly acknowledged recurring problems with road closures/route planning and pledged evaluation and improvements for future editions, suggesting logistics around road use remain a live issue.

Some residents on social media expressed skepticism that lessons from the prior year's complaints were being applied, indicating community friction around the race is a recurring theme rather than a one-off.

faqs.question: When is the Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 19, 2026. It will be held in the city of Bandung, Indonesia. This date applies to both the 21.1 km half-marathon and the 10 km distance offered as part of the event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers two distances for participants to choose from: a 21.1 km half-marathon, which is the primary distance for this race, and a shorter 10 km option. Both distances are part of the same Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 – Bandung is currently open. Prospective participants can sign up for either the 21.1 km half-marathon or the 10 km distance ahead of the event date of September 19, 2026.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in Bandung, Indonesia, though the exact venue within the city has not been specified in the available information. Runners interested in participating should watch for further venue details as the September 19, 2026 event date approaches.
